countries.name: Russia
countries.description: A civilizational pattern of ascetic self-punishment displacing accountability: suffering is treated as purification, dissent as pollution, and the state's guilt is metabolized through collective endurance rather than acknowledgment.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.description: A nation holding an unresolved founding wound at arm's length — historical rupture reframed as necessary sacrifice, guilt deflected into narratives of external threat rather than integrated as shared memory.

countries.name: Japan
countries.description: A culture where guilt is heavily ritualized and formally discharged (apology, resignation, ceremony) but the underlying accountability often stays procedural rather than transformative — the form of atonement without full metabolization.

countries.name: United States
countries.description: A civilizational pattern of guilt held in tension with mythologized innocence — real historical accountability efforts (truth commissions, reparative movements) coexisting with strong cultural resistance to full acknowledgment.

countries.name: France
countries.description: A nation actively wrestling its colonial and wartime guilt into public discourse — closer to integration than denial, but still marked by episodic rather than continuous accountability.

countries.name: Canada
countries.description: A visible, institutionalized move toward accountability (formal apologies, truth and reconciliation processes) — genuine movement toward the integrated pole, though implementation still lags acknowledgment.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.description: A civilization that underwent an unusually direct reckoning with state violence — trials, memorials, and public memory work that pushed hard toward accountability after a period of ascetic national silence.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.description: The paradigmatic modern case of formal, structured accountability — Truth and Reconciliation as a deliberate civilizational technology for metabolizing collective guilt rather than suppressing it.

countries.name: Rwanda
countries.description: A nation that built literal community-level justice infrastructure (gacaca courts) after catastrophic violence — accountability pursued as a matter of civilizational survival, not abstraction.

countries.name: Germany
countries.description: The closest civilizational approach to full integration on this axis — sustained, institutionalized, multi-generational confrontation with guilt (Vergangenheitsbewältigung) as an ongoing national practice rather than a closed chapter.

characters.name: Rev. Ernst Toller
characters.note: A pastor's ecological despair mutates into private ritual and a longing for martyrdom; his diary is both confession and suicide note.
characters.synopsis: A small-town pastor's ecological despair curdles into private ritual and thoughts of martyrdom.

characters.name: Christopher McCandless
characters.note: Renames his family's wounds as freedom and starves himself into myth, seeking a purity the wild can't actually grant.
characters.synopsis: A young man abandons his possessions and family to seek purity alone in the Alaskan wild.

characters.name: Travis Bickle
characters.note: An insomniac's disgust with the city curdles into a private, violent moral mission disguised as cleansing.
characters.synopsis: An insomniac cabbie's disgust with the city hardens into a private, violent moral mission.

characters.name: Tomas Ericsson
characters.note: A pastor paralyzed by his own lost faith, punishing himself for a cosmic crime he can feel but never name.
characters.synopsis: A widowed pastor's crisis of faith unfolds across one bleak Sunday of failed counsel.

characters.name: Erika Kohut
characters.note: A disciplined pianist stages her own humiliation, scripting fantasies that invert the control she maintains by day.
characters.synopsis: A repressed, exacting piano instructor stages her own humiliation with a besotted student.

characters.name: Sister Clodagh
characters.note: A nun's authority over a failing Himalayan convent cracks under altitude, isolation, and a desire she won't name.
characters.synopsis: Nuns founding a Himalayan convent are undone by altitude, isolation, and unspoken longing.

characters.name: Bobby Sands
characters.note: An IRA prisoner turns his own body into the last instrument of political witness available to him.
characters.synopsis: IRA prisoner Bobby Sands starves himself in a final act of political witness.

characters.name: Grace Mulligan
characters.note: A fugitive's gratitude toward the town sheltering her curdles, through escalating humiliation, into total reversal.
characters.synopsis: A fugitive woman's gratitude toward a small town curdles into ritualized humiliation and revenge.

characters.name: Father James Lavelle
characters.note: A good priest is given a week to live for another man's sins, and chooses to withstand his parish's darkness rather than flee it.
characters.synopsis: A good priest is given a week to live after being threatened for another man's sins.

characters.name: Freddie Quell
characters.note: A war-haunted drifter craves surrender to a master who can never actually hold him.
characters.synopsis: A drifting WWII veteran is drawn into the orbit of a charismatic postwar guru.

characters.name: Lancaster Dodd
characters.note: A self-appointed guru needs disciples like air, and his warmth curdles into rage the instant real intimacy threatens his authority.
characters.synopsis: A drifting WWII veteran is drawn into the orbit of a charismatic postwar guru.

characters.name: Curtis LaForche
characters.note: A husband's visions of an apocalyptic storm may be prophecy, inherited madness, or both at once.
characters.synopsis: A husband's visions of an apocalyptic storm may be prophecy or the onset of madness.

characters.name: She
characters.note: A grieving mother's unprocessed guilt over her child's death metastasizes into something the film stages as literal, monstrous nature.
characters.synopsis: A grieving couple's retreat to the woods unravels into nature-soaked psychological horror.

characters.name: Mother
characters.note: A poet's wife watches her home and self consumed by an ever-multiplying procession of uninvited need.
characters.synopsis: A poet's wife watches her home, and self, consumed by ever-multiplying uninvited guests.

characters.name: Dr. Bill Harford
characters.note: A husband's night-long spiral after his wife's confession is an attempt to reclaim a possession he never actually had.
characters.synopsis: A doctor's night of erotic temptation exposes the fault lines in his marriage.

characters.name: Alice Harford
characters.note: Her one confessed fantasy shatters the psychic conspiracy of a marriage built on polite not-looking.
characters.synopsis: A doctor's night of erotic temptation exposes the fault lines in his marriage.

characters.name: Dr. Stephen Fleming
characters.note: A father's affair with his son's fiancée is less desire than a controlled detonation of his own life.
characters.synopsis: A civil servant's affair with his son's fiancée detonates his family.

characters.name: Connie Sumner
characters.note: An affair explodes the boundary of marital expectation until her husband's jealousy turns fatal.
characters.synopsis: A suburban wife's affair spirals into concealment and violence.

characters.name: Lee Holloway
characters.note: A self-harming young woman finds, through her boss's discipline, a structure that turns punishment into self-discovery.
characters.synopsis: A submissive office assistant and her controlling boss discover intimacy through discipline.

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.note: The dominant partner in a ritualized relationship, worn thin by the exhausting labor of playing the role her lover needs.
characters.synopsis: Two women's domestic life is structured entirely around ritualized dominance and submission.

characters.name: Evelyn
characters.note: The submissive partner, whose appetite for ritual outpaces what her lover can sustain, straining the relationship's script.
characters.synopsis: Two women's domestic life is structured entirely around ritualized dominance and submission.

characters.name: Vanda
characters.note: An actress auditioning for a Sacher-Masoch adaptation slowly reverses the power dynamic with the director who thought he was in control.
characters.synopsis: A director and actress's audition becomes a power struggle mirroring the play itself.

characters.name: O
characters.note: A woman consents to total submission, offering her autonomy up so completely the story never lets her return from it.
characters.synopsis: A woman submits completely to her lover's demands for total obedience.

characters.name: Marianne
characters.note: A painter's muse endures a grueling, exposing sitting that becomes less about art than about who can outlast whom.
characters.synopsis: An aging painter's obsessive final portrait becomes a battle of wills with his model.

characters.name: Michèle Leblanc
characters.note: A woman refuses the script of victimhood after an assault, reclaiming agency in ways the film refuses to morally resolve.
characters.synopsis: A woman methodically hunts the man who assaulted her while refusing the role of victim.

characters.name: Anna Cameron
characters.note: A photographer caught between two men whose confessions weaponize honesty itself as a form of cruelty.
characters.synopsis: Two couples' affairs and betrayals strip intimacy down to cruelty and need.

characters.name: Amy Dunne
characters.note: A wife scripts her own disappearance as the ultimate performance of a marriage built on mutual myth-making.
characters.synopsis: A wife's disappearance unravels a marriage built on performance and control.

characters.name: Nick Dunne
characters.note: A husband forced to perform grief and innocence for the cameras while his marriage is revealed as a battleground he's already losing.
characters.synopsis: A wife's disappearance unravels a marriage built on performance and control.

characters.name: Eva Khatchadourian
characters.note: A mother lives in exile within her own life, unable to unsee what her son became or her own complicity in it.
characters.filmTitle: We Need to Talk About Kevin
characters.synopsis: A mother reckons with her son's atrocity and her own complicity.

characters.name: Brandon Sullivan
characters.note: A sex addict's meticulously controlled life collapses the moment his sister's need intrudes on it.
characters.synopsis: A sex addict's controlled life collapses when his sister moves in.

characters.name: Joe
characters.note: A woman narrates her own sexual history as confession, refusing both shame and redemption as the frame for her story.
characters.synopsis: A woman recounts her sexual history to the stranger who found her beaten in an alley.

characters.name: Sada Abe
characters.note: An obsession with her lover spirals past pleasure into ritual and, finally, annihilation.
characters.filmTitle: In the Realm of the Senses
characters.synopsis: A consuming sexual obsession between two lovers escalates toward annihilation.

characters.name: Sook-hee
characters.note: A con artist sent to swindle an heiress finds the scheme, and her own loyalties, reversing under her.
characters.synopsis: A con artist and her mark fall into a spiraling, deception-laced seduction.

characters.name: Franck
characters.note: A man's summer at a cruising spot keeps him returning to a lover he knows is dangerous, desire outweighing every warning.
characters.synopsis: A cruising spot's summer idyll turns lethal when desire outweighs danger.

characters.name: Adèle
characters.note: A teenager's first love reorganizes her entire sense of who she is, and who she becomes when it ends.
characters.synopsis: A teenager's first love with an older art student reshapes her identity.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.note: A cinephile's intimacy with her twin brother and their American guest blurs into a private world that can't survive contact with the history outside it.
characters.synopsis: An American student's friendship with French cinephile twins dissolves into obsession.

characters.name: Helen
characters.note: A hospitalized teenager's frank, confrontational relationship with her own body doubles as rebellion against her family's repression.
characters.synopsis: A hospitalized teenager's frank hedonism confronts her family's buried dysfunction.

characters.name: Anaïs
characters.note: A younger sister watches her sibling's seduction and destruction, absorbing both envy and a warped rehearsal for her own coming violation.
characters.synopsis: Two sisters' first sexual experiences expose the cruelty underneath desire.

characters.name: Betty
characters.note: A volatile, passionate woman's love affair accelerates toward a breakdown neither she nor her lover can arrest.
characters.synopsis: A volatile woman's passionate love affair spirals toward breakdown.

characters.name: Catherine Tramell
characters.note: A novelist under suspicion of murder controls every room she's in, including the investigation meant to control her.
characters.synopsis: A detective's investigation of a novelist entangles him in a lethal seduction.

characters.name: Chris Wilton
characters.note: An ambitious social climber's affair threatens the marriage that secured his rise, and he chooses murder over exposure.
characters.synopsis: An ambitious social climber's affair threatens the marriage that secured his rise.

characters.name: Ronit Krushka
characters.note: A woman's return to the Orthodox community she fled reignites a love she was never allowed to name.
characters.synopsis: A woman's return to her Orthodox community reignites a forbidden past love.

characters.name: Tomas
characters.note: A filmmaker's affair destabilizes his marriage through sheer narcissistic refusal to choose, or to stop taking.
characters.synopsis: A filmmaker's affair with a woman destabilizes his marriage to another man.

characters.name: The narrator
characters.note: A woman's consuming affair with a foreign diplomat reorganizes her entire existence around waiting for him.
characters.synopsis: A woman's consuming affair with a foreign diplomat reorganizes her entire life around waiting.

characters.name: Bella Cherry
characters.note: An aspiring performer's ambition in the adult film industry costs her more agency than it grants her.
characters.synopsis: A young Swedish woman's ambitions in the LA porn industry cost her more than expected.

characters.name: Benedetta Carlini
characters.note: A nun's visions and forbidden desire collide with the convent's own power politics, blurring ecstasy and manipulation.
characters.synopsis: A 17th-century nun's visions and same-sex desire collide with convent power politics.

characters.name: Hunter
characters.note: A controlled, pregnant housewife develops a compulsion to swallow dangerous objects as the only agency left to her.
characters.synopsis: A pregnant, controlled housewife develops a compulsion to swallow dangerous objects.

characters.name: Pippa
characters.note: A young woman's fascination with watching her neighbors curdles into obsession and dangerous exposure.
characters.synopsis: A young couple's fascination with watching their neighbors turns dangerous.

characters.name: Lea
characters.note: A teenage girl's relationship with an older man reveals itself, slowly and devastatingly, as grooming.
characters.synopsis: A teenage girl's relationship with an older man reveals it as grooming.

characters.name: Ai
characters.note: A young dominatrix drifts through Tokyo's underworld of wealth and submission, searching for a self underneath the transactions.
characters.synopsis: A young dominatrix drifts through Tokyo's underworld of wealth and submission.

characters.name: Frannie Avery
characters.note: A writing teacher's affair with the detective investigating a nearby murder blurs her desire and her danger past any safe distance.
characters.synopsis: A writing teacher's affair with a detective investigating a murder blurs desire and danger.

characters.name: Marianne
characters.note: A divorce lawyer spends a decade discovering, scene by scene, that the calm competence she brings to other people's marriages cannot diagnose the quiet exhaustion inside her own.
characters.synopsis: A married couple dissects the slow disintegration of their intimacy over ten years, then discovers their emotional bond outlives the marriage itself.

characters.name: Nicole Barber
characters.note: An actress who spent years making her husband's directing career the center of the household channels her long-deferred resentment into a legal process that turns mutual care into adversarial weaponry.
characters.synopsis: A married couple's amicable coast-to-coast divorce curdles, through lawyers and legal maneuvering, into a bitter custody war neither of them wanted.

characters.name: Cindy
characters.note: An ambitious young woman burdened by a troubled family and a toxic ex finds Dean's romantic, plan-free devotion endearing at first sight and suffocating a few years later, once a child and a stalled career recast charm as immaturity.
characters.synopsis: A young marriage's giddy origin and its bitter present-day collapse are told in interwoven timelines that reveal how the same traits sustained and then destroyed the couple.

characters.name: April Wheeler
characters.note: A former aspiring actress who married Frank believing him an escape from conformity engineers a doomed plan to move the family to Paris, and destroys herself when his fear of freedom reveals he was the conformity all along.
characters.synopsis: A 1950s suburban couple's shared dream of escaping to Paris curdles into recrimination and mutual destruction when the husband's fear overtakes the plan.

characters.name: Francesca Johnson
characters.note: An Italian war bride settled into two decades of dutiful Iowa farm life discovers, in four days with a wandering photographer, a self she had shelved for marriage, then chooses to bury that self again rather than abandon her family.
characters.synopsis: A farmwife's brief, transformative affair with a visiting photographer becomes the private center of gravity she carries silently for the rest of her married life.

characters.name: Alex Forrest
characters.note: A publishing editor treats a weekend affair with a married man as the start of a real relationship, and when he retreats to his family, her refusal to accept the limit escalates from persistence to stalking to violence against his household.
characters.synopsis: A married man's weekend affair with a colleague spirals, once he tries to end it, into an escalating campaign of stalking and violence aimed at his wife and daughter.

characters.name: Barbara Rose
characters.note: A homemaker who built a picture-perfect house around her husband's rising career admits, after his health scare fails to move her, that she feels only contempt for him, and fights him for sole possession of the home rather than any settlement.
characters.synopsis: A once-happy couple's divorce over their beautifully appointed house escalates into an increasingly vicious, ultimately fatal domestic war.

characters.name: Sarah Pierce
characters.note: A stalled academic turned stay-at-home mother, neither maternally content nor openly rebellious, initiates a daily-scheduled affair with another neglected parent that briefly makes suburban complacency feel survivable.
characters.synopsis: Two dissatisfied suburban parents fall into a daily affair that exposes the quiet desperation underneath their marriages and their town's moral surveillance.

characters.name: Mary
characters.note: A single, anxious friend of a contentedly married couple masks her loneliness with brittle liveliness, drinks to cope, and fixes her hopes on their much younger son, only to be gently but firmly folded back into her isolation each year.
characters.synopsis: A settled, contented couple's stability is contrasted across four seasons with the unraveling loneliness of their single friend Mary.

characters.name: Margot
characters.note: A freelance writer married to a comfortable, affectionate man finds herself pulled toward a neighbor's novelty, and leaves her marriage for the new relationship only to discover the restlessness travels with her.
characters.synopsis: A married woman's growing attraction to her neighbor tests, and ultimately breaks, the comfortable shape of her marriage, without resolving her underlying restlessness.

characters.name: Simin
characters.note: A mother petitions to leave Iran with her daughter for a better future and, refused by her husband's devotion to his ailing father, files for divorce, setting off a class-and-caregiving dispute that exposes the whole family's moral compromises.
characters.synopsis: A Tehran couple's request for divorce, driven by the wife's wish to emigrate and the husband's duty to his father, unravels into a class-crossing dispute over truth, honor, and blame.

characters.name: Marianne
characters.note: An actress recounts, to an aging director who is effectively interrogating his own conscience, how her affair with her husband's best friend dissolved her marriage and devastated her daughter, narrating her own culpability without absolution.
characters.synopsis: A woman recounts to an imagined director-figure the affair with her husband's best friend that destroyed her marriage and devastated her daughter.

characters.name: Leon Zat
characters.note: A married police detective in midlife crisis begins an affair with a dance-class acquaintance, and only through a chain of interlocking suburban griefs and a wiretapped confession of his wife's abiding love does he turn back toward reconciliation.
characters.synopsis: A detective's affair and a woman's disappearance interlock several suburban marriages, revealing how proximity and intimacy are not the same thing among couples who barely understand each other.

characters.name: Hester Collyer
characters.note: A judge's wife leaves her kind, emotionally stifling husband for a volatile ex-RAF pilot's consuming passion, and finds herself suspended, in her own unreliable memory, between the devil of comfort and the deep blue sea of destructive desire.
characters.synopsis: A woman leaves her comfortable, emotionally distant marriage for a consuming affair with a former RAF pilot that proves unable to sustain her happiness.

characters.name: Rachel Grimes
characters.note: A once-bohemian writer approaching midlife pursues IVF and adoption alongside her husband with escalating clinical desperation, letting the couple's stalled careers and creative identities be steadily displaced by the mechanics of trying to conceive.
characters.synopsis: A couple's prolonged, clinical struggle with infertility through IVF and adoption strains their marriage and exposes their stalled creative and personal ambitions.

characters.name: Lynsey
characters.note: A soldier returning from Afghanistan with a brain injury forms a tentative, wary friendship with a grieving mechanic, each testing how much closeness their damaged, guarded selves can risk without repeating the ruptures of their pasts.
characters.synopsis: A soldier's slow, injury-marked recovery in New Orleans becomes intertwined with a grieving mechanic's own guardedness, as both test how much intimacy they can bear.

characters.name: Nicholas
characters.note: A depressive teenager performs recovery for his divorced parents while concealing self-harm, converting their inability to hear him into a private countdown toward suicide.
characters.synopsis: A father tries to reach his depressed teenage son before it's too late.

characters.name: Lee Chandler
characters.note: A janitor who accidentally caused the fire that killed his three children refuses every offer of absolution, choosing exile and stillness over forgiveness he cannot metabolize.
characters.synopsis: A man returns to his hometown to raise his nephew, haunted by an unforgivable past.

characters.name: Ryota Yokoyama
characters.note: The surviving younger son attends his family's yearly ritual mourning his drowned brother, absorbing his parents' unspoken preference for the dead child as a lifelong verdict on his own worth.
characters.synopsis: A family's annual gathering to mourn a dead son reveals unspoken resentments.

characters.name: Conor O'Malley
characters.note: A boy summons a mythic monster to force him past the comforting lie of his mother's recovery into the unbearable truth that part of him wants her suffering, and his own, to end.
characters.synopsis: A boy's mother's terminal illness summons a mythic tree monster who tells him truths.

characters.name: Billi
characters.note: An Americanized granddaughter is enlisted into her family's collective lie that keeps Nai Nai's terminal cancer diagnosis from her, forcing grief into performance and staged celebration.
characters.synopsis: A family hides a grandmother's terminal diagnosis from her, per cultural custom.

characters.name: Martha Weiss
characters.note: A mother whose home birth ends in her newborn's death refuses legible grief, going numb, reckless, and unreadable while everyone around her demands a mourning performance she cannot give.
characters.synopsis: A couple's home birth ends in loss, fracturing their relationship and families.

characters.name: Jean-Dominique Bauby
characters.note: A magazine editor paralyzed by locked-in syndrome after a stroke reconstructs selfhood one blinked letter at a time, dictating a memoir from a body that has become a diving bell around an unbroken mind.
characters.filmTitle: The Diving Bell and the Butterfly
characters.synopsis: A paralyzed man communicates and finds meaning after a catastrophic stroke.

characters.name: Dante Remus Lăzărescu
characters.note: An ailing, alcoholic pensioner is passed between indifferent Bucharest hospitals over a single night, his dying reduced to a logistical nuisance no institution will claim responsibility for.
characters.synopsis: A dying man is shuttled between hospitals by an indifferent medical system.

characters.name: David Sheff
characters.note: A journalist father cycles through hope, relapse, and helplessness as his son's meth addiction resists every intervention, his love for the 'beautiful boy' colliding with his inability to save him.
characters.synopsis: A father struggles to save his son from methamphetamine addiction.

characters.name: Karoline
characters.note: A destitute, abandoned postwar seamstress drifts from desperation into complicity with a baby-farming murderer, her survival instinct curdling into the very predation that consumed her.
characters.synopsis: A destitute woman in postwar Copenhagen is drawn into a monstrous scheme.

characters.name: Sammy Prescott
characters.note: A single mother orphaned young by a car accident maintains rigid small-town stability until her drifting brother's return exposes how much of her control is itself an unhealed reaction to loss.
characters.synopsis: A single mother's stability is disrupted by her unreliable brother's return.

characters.name: Kathy H.
characters.note: A clone raised as an organ donor narrates her own foreshortened life through memory and small tendernesses, using recollection to soften a mortality she was engineered never to escape.
characters.synopsis: Cloned children raised for organ donation grapple with love and mortality.

characters.name: Leda Caruso
characters.note: A middle-aged academic's fixation on a young mother on a beach vacation reopens her own long-buried choice to abandon her small daughters, refusing to disguise motherhood's ambivalence as instinct.
characters.synopsis: A woman's fixation on a young mother stirs buried regret about her own children.

characters.name: Hugh Glass
characters.note: Left for dead and mauled to the bone, his survival becomes indistinguishable from vengeance, the wilderness stripping him to pure animal will with no residue of civilized restraint.
characters.synopsis: A frontiersman left for dead survives betrayal and wilderness to seek revenge.

characters.name: Jeremiah Johnson
characters.note: A man's flight from society into the mountains, meant as peace, instead escalates through mistaken transgression into a private war that erases the self he set out to find.
characters.synopsis: A man's retreat into the mountains as a trapper draws him into a war with the Crow.

characters.name: Dick Proenneke
characters.note: A retired machinist's solitary construction of a cabin by hand becomes a demonstration that self-sufficiency, patiently performed, can substitute entirely for society without any trace of longing for it.
characters.synopsis: A man builds a self-sufficient cabin life alone in the Alaskan wilderness.

characters.name: Cory Lambert
characters.note: A tracker's mastery of the frozen land becomes a proxy for the grief he cannot track down directly, the reservation's wilderness exposing how little law or nature protects the vulnerable there.
characters.synopsis: A tracker and rookie FBI agent investigate a death on a remote reservation.

characters.name: Ottway
characters.note: A suicidal wolf-hunter's crash-survival strips him of the death wish he arrived with, forcing him to choose life through combat with the very predators that mirror his own numbness.
characters.synopsis: Plane crash survivors fight wolves and cold in the Alaskan wilderness.

characters.name: Will
characters.note: A veteran's engineered isolation with his daughter reveals that his own trauma, not the forest, is the real enclosure, and that her need to rejoin the world outpaces his need to flee it.
characters.synopsis: A veteran father and daughter's off-grid forest life collides with the outside world.

characters.name: Cheryl Strayed
characters.note: An unprepared, grief-wracked woman's eleven-hundred-mile solo hike turns physical depletion into the only available discipline for grieving a mother and forgiving her own self-destruction.
characters.synopsis: A woman hikes the Pacific Crest Trail alone to process grief and addiction.

characters.name: Horst Kauffmann
characters.note: A German pilot stranded with his enemies in a snowbound cabin finds that shared cold and hunger dissolve the wartime hierarchy faster than any order, exposing allegiance as circumstantial.
characters.synopsis: Enemy WWII pilots shelter together after crashing in the Norwegian snow.

characters.name: Emily Tetherow
characters.note: A settler's dawning realization that her party's guide is either a liar or simply lost turns the desert into a referendum on which male authority, if any, deserves her trust.
characters.synopsis: Settlers on the Oregon Trail lose faith in their guide amid the desert.

characters.name: Nathaniel 'Hawkeye' Poe
characters.note: A frontiersman raised between two worlds discovers that wilderness expertise cannot shield the people he loves from a colonial war that treats all territory, and all bodies, as claimable.
characters.synopsis: A frontiersman protects colonial sisters amid the French and Indian War.

characters.name: Lt. John Dunbar
characters.note: A soldier posted to the empty frontier as a kind of death wish instead finds a Lakota community that gives him a self worth living for, making his original uniform the true wilderness he escapes.
characters.synopsis: A Union soldier stationed on the frontier is assimilated into Lakota life.

characters.name: Will Andrews
characters.note: A Harvard dropout's romantic pursuit of transcendence through buffalo hunting curdles into complicity in slaughter and stranding, the wilderness exposing his idealism as a young man's vanity.
characters.synopsis: A young Harvard dropout joins a doomed buffalo-hunting expedition.

characters.name: Dieter Dengler
characters.note: A downed pilot's near-manic refusal to die in the Laotian jungle, fed by childhood memories of postwar starvation, turns captivity and escape into a test of appetite for life itself.
characters.synopsis: A downed pilot endures a Laotian POW camp and jungle escape.

characters.name: Robyn Davidson
characters.note: A woman's self-imposed crossing of seventeen hundred miles of desert with camels turns solitude from an escape from public attention into the discipline that finally makes her legible to herself.
characters.synopsis: A woman crosses the Australian desert alone with camels and a dog.

characters.name: Percy Fawcett
characters.note: An explorer's hunger to redeem a tainted family name through discovery hardens into an obsession that consumes his marriage, his sons, and finally his own body inside the Amazon's silence.
characters.synopsis: An explorer becomes obsessed with a lost Amazonian civilization.

characters.name: Janusz
characters.note: A Gulag escapee's four-thousand-mile walk toward freedom converts sheer geographic distance into the only proof of innocence available to a man the state has already declared guilty.
characters.synopsis: Gulag escapees walk thousands of miles across Asia toward freedom.

characters.name: Karamakate
characters.note: The last of his people, a shaman guiding two white explorers decades apart toward a sacred plant discovers that knowledge given to outsiders becomes extraction, and that his own memory is the true endangered species.
characters.synopsis: An Amazonian shaman guides two explorers decades apart toward the same sacred plant.

characters.name: James Brooke
characters.note: A British adventurer's self-styled crusade against piracy and slavery in Borneo reveals itself as its own species of conquest, benevolence indistinguishable from the rule he claims to oppose.
characters.synopsis: An adventurer's expedition into Borneo's jungle becomes a colonial reckoning.

characters.name: Dersu Uzala
characters.note: An aging Siberian hunter's animist fluency with the taiga exposes the surveyor's instruments as blunt tools, and his eventual dependence on civilization becomes the thing that kills him.
characters.synopsis: A Russian surveyor's friendship with an aging Siberian hunter reshapes his worldview.

characters.name: Capt. Joseph Blocker
characters.note: A cavalry officer ordered to escort the dying Cheyenne chief he once hunted must strip away decades of manufactured hatred across open frontier, discovering his cruelty was policy, not nature.
characters.synopsis: A cavalry officer escorts a dying Cheyenne chief home across hostile frontier.

characters.name: Mary Bee Cuddy
characters.note: A frontierswoman's solitary competence, refused by every eligible man, is finally spent transporting three women broken by the plains, her own sanity proving no sturdier than theirs by the end.
characters.synopsis: A frontierswoman and a claim-jumper transport three mentally ill women across the plains.

characters.name: Charlie Burns
characters.note: An outlaw offered his younger brother's life in exchange for killing his older brother is forced to choose which blood tie the law will let him keep, the outback offering no neutral ground.
characters.synopsis: An outlaw is offered his brother's life for hunting down their older brother.

characters.name: Daniel Dillon
characters.note: A boomtown founder who once traded his wife and infant daughter for a gold claim watches his engineered prosperity collapse the instant they return, wealth proving no substitute for the debt.
characters.synopsis: A frontier boomtown founder is confronted by the wife and daughter he once traded away.

characters.name: Arthur O'Dwyer
characters.note: A frontier sheriff's rescue mission into caveland gives law and civility nothing to hold onto against a tribe that lives entirely outside language, reducing rescue to butchery on both sides.
characters.synopsis: Frontier settlers rescue captives from a cave-dwelling cannibal tribe.

characters.name: One-Eye
characters.note: A mute Norse warrior's silent, near-supernatural violence follows Crusaders on a voyage that reveals itself as a passage toward damnation rather than a new promised land, faith and slaughter fusing into one rite.
characters.synopsis: A mute Norse warrior leads Crusaders on a doomed voyage to a new land.

characters.name: Amleth
characters.note: A Viking prince's childhood vow of vengeance fossilizes into his entire identity, so that fulfilling it in the volcanic wilderness of his birth becomes indistinguishable from self-annihilation.
characters.synopsis: A Viking prince pursues ancestral revenge against the uncle who murdered his father.

characters.name: Sir Gawain
characters.note: A young knight's honor-bound journey to accept a beheading strips away every excuse and shortcut he invents along the way, until only the choice to actually keep his word remains.
characters.synopsis: A young knight's quest to honor a game of honor becomes a trial of character.

characters.name: Inman
characters.note: A wounded deserter's cross-country trek home converts military desertion into the only moral clarity the war affords him, the wilderness between him and Ada becoming the last honest terrain.
characters.synopsis: A wounded Confederate deserter treks home to the woman he loves.

characters.name: Mattie Ross
characters.note: A fourteen-year-old's relentless pursuit of her father's killer across Indian Territory converts grief into contractual will, forcing the men she hires to match a resolve that never once wavers.
characters.synopsis: A teenage girl hires a U.S. Marshal to hunt her father's killer.

characters.name: Eli Sisters
characters.note: A gunman touring the frontier at his violent brother's side finds the pursuit of a prospector's gold-panning formula cracking open a quieter appetite for domestic peace he barely knew he had.
characters.synopsis: Two outlaw brothers pursue a prospector with a secret gold-panning formula.

characters.name: Buster Scruggs
characters.note: A singing gunslinger's cheerful invincibility across the frontier is revealed as narrative artifice the instant a faster draw appears, mortality arriving as punchline rather than tragedy.
characters.synopsis: Six vignettes trace mortality and chance across the American frontier.

characters.name: Lefty Brown
characters.note: A perennial sidekick, dismissed his whole life as comic relief, must ride alone to avenge his partner's murder and discovers competence and grief the frontier never credited him with.
characters.synopsis: An aging sidekick avenges his partner's murder alone.

characters.name: Llewelyn Moss
characters.note: A hunter's opportunistic theft of drug money on the open scrubland summons a killer whose logic is closer to natural law than crime, exposing the frontier's terrain as morally unpoliced.
characters.synopsis: A hunter's discovery of drug money draws a relentless killer's pursuit.

characters.name: Quintus Dias
characters.note: A Roman soldier fleeing deep into Pictish wilderness after his legion's massacre finds imperial identity worthless against terrain and enemies that answer only to their own laws of survival.
characters.synopsis: A Roman legion's survivors flee deep into hostile Pictish territory.

characters.name: Robert the Bruce
characters.note: A claimant to the Scottish throne, stripped of army and legitimacy, is forced into guerrilla survival across highland wilderness that remakes his kingship as something earned in mud rather than granted by crown.
characters.synopsis: Robert the Bruce wages guerrilla war to reclaim the Scottish throne.

characters.name: Overgard
characters.note: A plane-crash survivor's solitary trek across Arctic ice reduces salvation to logistics -- calories, distance, daylight -- with no interiority left over for anything but the next measured step.
characters.synopsis: A plane crash survivor treks across the Arctic for rescue.

characters.name: Rob Hall
characters.note: An expedition leader's commercial promise to get paying clients to the summit collides with a mountain that honors no itinerary, his professional obligation to others outlasting his own survival instinct.
characters.synopsis: Climbers on Everest are caught in a catastrophic storm.

characters.name: Lawrence Allestad
characters.note: An aging Montana sheepherder's final season driving flock through mountain terrain records a livelihood and a landscape both nearing extinction, his labor the last performance of a vanishing pact with the land.
characters.synopsis: Montana sheepherders drive their flock through the mountains for a final season.

characters.name: Chris Taylor
characters.note: A volunteer private is pulled apart by two father-figure sergeants embodying war's capacity for both atrocity and grace, and emerges having absorbed both.
characters.synopsis: A young soldier's Vietnam tour becomes a moral battle between two sergeants.

characters.name: Ron Kovic
characters.note: A paralyzed veteran's shattered body forces a public unmaking and remaking of his patriotism, converting personal injury into political witness.
characters.filmTitle: Born on the Fourth of July
characters.synopsis: A paralyzed Vietnam veteran transforms from patriot to anti-war activist.

characters.name: Capt. Benjamin Willard
characters.note: Sent to assassinate a man who has 'gone beyond reason,' Willard's river journey dissolves the line between his mission and his own capacity for savagery.
characters.synopsis: A soldier's mission upriver to kill a rogue colonel becomes a descent into war's madness.

characters.name: Michael Vronsky
characters.note: A steelworker's ritualized code of control and precision, forged in deer hunting, is broken by Russian-roulette captivity and he returns unable to save his friends from its aftershocks.
characters.synopsis: Steelworker friends are shattered by their experience in the Vietnam War.

characters.name: Sally Hyde
characters.note: A dutiful officer's wife's awakening desire and conscience, sparked by caring for a paralyzed veteran, exposes the hollowness of the home-front war narrative she was raised to perform.
characters.synopsis: A soldier's wife falls for a paralyzed veteran while her husband is at war.

characters.name: Sgt. Kevin Kearney
characters.note: As de facto documentary protagonist of the isolated Restrepo outpost, his blunt grief for a fallen comrade on camera reveals combat leadership as a mask worn over unprocessed loss.
characters.synopsis: A platoon documents a year defending an outpost in Afghanistan's Korengal Valley.

characters.name: L.T. Bonham
characters.note: The tracker who trained an elite killer must hunt down his own pedagogical creation, his skill turned into an indictment of the violence he taught as a craft.
characters.synopsis: A tracker is enlisted to hunt down the elite soldier he trained.

characters.name: Hank Deerfield
characters.note: A career-military father's investigation into his son's death forces him to confront how the discipline and violence he instilled fed a war that broke the son beyond recognition.
characters.synopsis: A father investigates his son's mysterious death after returning from Iraq.

characters.name: Avner Kaufman
characters.note: A Mossad agent's assassination campaign for state vengeance corrodes his own sense of home and belonging, turning righteous retaliation into permanent, paranoid exile.
characters.synopsis: Israeli agents hunt the perpetrators of the Munich Olympics massacre.

characters.name: Ari Folman
characters.note: An animated stand-in for the director interrogates his own suppressed memory of the Sabra and Shatila massacre, his amnesia itself a psychic defense against complicity.
characters.synopsis: An animated veteran reconstructs his suppressed memories of the Lebanon War.

characters.name: Maximus Decimus Meridius
characters.note: A general stripped of family and rank is remade in the arena, where the state's spectacle of violence becomes the only stage left for him to reclaim honor and revenge.
characters.synopsis: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator seeking revenge on the emperor.

characters.name: Jean de Carrouges
characters.note: A knight's honor culture converts his wife's rape into a referendum on his own reputation, settling her trauma through ritualized combat that centers his violence over her truth.
characters.synopsis: A rape accusation is settled by trial-by-combat, told from three perspectives.

characters.name: Macbeth
characters.note: A battlefield hero's martial valor curdles into prophecy-fueled ambition, so that the violence that won him honor becomes the same instrument that hollows him into a tyrant.
characters.synopsis: A Scottish lord's prophecy-fueled ambition drives him to regicide and ruin.

characters.name: Macbeth
characters.note: Kurzel's war-hero Macbeth carries visible battlefield PTSD into his crown, his hallucinatory violence read as trauma metastasizing into tyranny rather than simple villainy.
characters.synopsis: A war hero's ambition and a witches' prophecy drive him to murder his king.

characters.name: Ernest Burkhart
characters.note: A pliant husband's love for his Osage wife is subordinated to his uncle's orchestrated murders for headright oil money, his complicity a slow, willful self-betrayal disguised as loyalty.
characters.synopsis: Osage Nation murders for oil wealth are orchestrated from within a family.

characters.name: Solomon Northup
characters.note: A free man's identity is systematically erased through kidnapping and bondage, his survival demanding he perform submission while guarding an interior self slavery cannot reach.
characters.synopsis: A free Black man is kidnapped and sold into slavery in the antebellum South.

characters.name: Newton Knight
characters.note: A Confederate deserter's disgust at a rich man's war radicalizes him into leading an interracial swamp rebellion, converting personal desertion into a durable, communal insurgency.
characters.synopsis: A Confederate deserter leads a multiracial rebellion against the Confederacy.

characters.name: Harriet Tubman
characters.note: Visionary seizures and a hard-won escape convert Tubman's private trauma into a compulsive, repeated return to danger, her freedom incomplete until shared with those still enslaved.
characters.synopsis: Harriet Tubman escapes slavery and returns repeatedly to free others.

characters.name: Col. Robert Gould Shaw
characters.note: A young white officer commanding the first Black Union regiment is forced to fight the army's own racism before he can lead his men into the suicidal assault that proves their dignity.
characters.synopsis: The first all-Black Union regiment fights for dignity and recognition in the Civil War.

characters.name: Amsterdam Vallon
characters.note: A son's vow of revenge against his father's killer requires years of infiltration and feigned loyalty, so that vengeance becomes indistinguishable from the gang violence it seeks to end.
characters.synopsis: A young man infiltrates the gang that killed his father to seek revenge.

characters.name: Abraham Lincoln
characters.note: A war-weary president trades and maneuvers through political compromise to pass the 13th Amendment, weighing the moral cost of expedient horse-trading against ending slavery and the war itself.
characters.synopsis: Lincoln maneuvers Congress to pass the 13th Amendment as the Civil War ends.

characters.name: Freddie Quell
characters.note: A shattered, alcoholic drifter submits to Lancaster Dodd's 'processing' rituals not from doctrinal belief but from a starved need for a father figure to organize his chaos.
characters.synopsis: A drifting WWII veteran is drawn into the orbit of a charismatic postwar guru.

characters.name: Will Allen
characters.note: The cult's own videographer, Allen surrendered his creative eye and decades of footage to leader Michel Rostand's cult of personality, only later reclaiming it as evidence of manipulation.
characters.synopsis: A former member's home videos document decades inside a secretive spiritual cult.

characters.name: L. Ron Hubbard
characters.note: The absent founder whose invented cosmology and auditing technology became a self-sealing system, converting personal disclosure into permanent leverage over followers.
characters.synopsis: Former Scientologists detail the church's methods of control and abuse.

characters.name: Maggie
characters.note: A cult leader who manufactures intimacy through staged vulnerability and time-travel prophecy, binding infiltrators to her by making belief feel like being chosen.
characters.synopsis: Documentarians infiltrating a cult begin to believe its leader's claims.

characters.name: Martha
characters.note: Renamed 'Marcy May' by a communal farm's leader, Martha absorbed his sexual and psychological grooming as intimacy, leaving her unable to distinguish memory from ongoing threat.
characters.synopsis: A woman fleeing a cult struggles to readjust to normal life.

characters.name: Sandra
characters.note: A fast-food manager whose reflexive deference to an authoritative phone voice claiming police authority overrides her own judgment, escalating into the strip-search of an employee.
characters.synopsis: A prank caller manipulates a fast-food manager into abusing an employee.

characters.name: Abin Cooper
characters.note: A Westboro-style patriarch whose fire-and-brimstone sermons fuse scripture with paranoid militarism, turning his own family compound into an armed extension of his will.
characters.synopsis: Teenagers are captured by a violent fundamentalist church compound.

characters.name: Eli Gemstone
characters.note: A televangelist patriarch who launders his family's greed and sin through the language of salvation, keeping his children bound to the ministry as both business and inherited shame.
characters.synopsis: A televangelist family's empire is riddled with hypocrisy and dysfunction.

characters.name: Dad Meiks (Adam Meiks)
characters.note: A father convinced of direct divine instruction converts his sons into an executioner's apprenticeship, with obedience to his visions the only proof of love or salvation he offers them.
characters.synopsis: A father convinces his sons that God has ordered them to kill demons.

characters.name: Euliss 'Sonny' Dewey (The Apostle E.F.)
characters.note: A disgraced, violent preacher baptizes himself into a new identity to outrun his own crimes, using revival-tent charisma to rebuild authority he no longer has the right to hold.
characters.synopsis: A disgraced preacher flees to start a new church and reckon with his sins.

characters.name: Harry Caul
characters.note: A surveillance expert's professional detachment collapses under guilt for a past job's fatal consequences, until his own paranoia mirrors the watching he practices on others.
characters.synopsis: A surveillance expert's own recording implicates him in a possible murder and spirals him into consuming paranoia.

characters.name: George Smiley
characters.note: A retired spymaster's cool analytical patience masks private devastation, as unmasking the Soviet mole means confronting the colleague and wife who both betrayed him.
characters.synopsis: A retired spymaster hunts a Soviet mole inside British intelligence.

characters.name: Jef Costello
characters.note: A contract killer's daily ritual of hat, coat, and silence substitutes for identity itself, so that a single botched job strips him of the only self he has.
characters.synopsis: A stoic hitman's perfect routine unravels after a botched job.

characters.name: Joseph Turner
characters.note: A bookish CIA analyst who reads thrillers for hidden codes becomes the thing he studies, hunted by his own agency for stumbling on a secret operation within it.
characters.synopsis: A CIA researcher goes on the run after his office is massacred.

characters.name: Roger Thornhill
characters.note: An advertising man whose profession is built on plausible fictions finds no one will believe his true story once he is mistaken for a spy who never existed.
characters.synopsis: An advertising executive is mistaken for a spy and pursued across the country.

characters.name: Robert Clayton Dean
characters.note: A labor lawyer's ordinary life is dismantled piece by piece — bank accounts, marriage, reputation — once a stranger's tape makes him a target of the surveillance state he never knew watched him.
characters.synopsis: A lawyer is targeted by rogue NSA agents after receiving incriminating footage.

characters.name: Nathan Muir
characters.note: A veteran spymaster's lifetime of manipulation and moral compromise culminates in one act of loyalty, breaking his own agency's rules to save the protégé he once sacrificed.
characters.synopsis: A retiring CIA officer maneuvers to save his protégé from execution abroad.

characters.name: James B. Donovan
characters.note: An insurance lawyer's stubborn insistence on due process, even for an enemy spy, becomes the era's most improbable weapon in a Cold War fought over principle rather than force.
characters.synopsis: A lawyer negotiates a Cold War prisoner exchange between the US and USSR.

characters.name: Colonel Katherine Powell
characters.note: A drone commander's six-year hunt for a terrorist target collapses into a real-time calculus of one child's life, and her composure hardens precisely where doubt should show.
characters.synopsis: Military and political officials debate a drone strike as civilian risk mounts in real time.

characters.name: Linda Litzke
characters.note: A gym employee's need for cosmetic self-reinvention drives her to weaponize a stray disk of stolen secrets, mistaking Cold War espionage machinery for a shortcut to self-worth.
characters.synopsis: A discarded memoir manuscript spirals into espionage farce among bumbling gym employees.

characters.name: Lorraine Broughton
characters.note: An MI6 agent's icy tactical composure conceals a loyalty owed to no single side, revealed as a triple-cross whose true allegiance was never the mission she appeared to serve.
characters.synopsis: A British spy navigates betrayal in divided Berlin as the Wall falls.

characters.name: Greville Wynne
characters.note: An unremarkable British businessman's willingness to smuggle Soviet secrets grows a conscience he didn't have, until loyalty to a source he barely knew costs him his old life entirely.
characters.synopsis: A British businessman becomes an unlikely spy passing Soviet secrets during the Cuban Missile Crisis.

characters.name: Kate Macer
characters.note: An FBI agent's by-the-book ethics are used as cover for a covert task force's extralegal war, until she realizes her presence was never oversight but legitimizing decoration.
characters.synopsis: An FBI agent is drawn into a morally murky task force fighting the drug war.

characters.name: Tom Farrell / Yuri
characters.note: A rising Pentagon officer is appointed to hunt the very Soviet mole he secretly is, so that solving the case he leads means unmasking and destroying himself.
characters.synopsis: A Naval officer's affair entangles him in a murder investigation he must deflect from himself.

characters.name: John "Scottie" Ferguson
characters.note: A detective's surveillance of a woman he's paid to shadow curdles into obsessive love, and when she dies he tries to resurrect her by remaking a second woman in her image.
characters.synopsis: A detective's obsession with a woman he's shadowing spirals into deception and doubling.

characters.name: Rick Deckard
characters.note: A bounty hunter retiring escaped replicants finds the empathy test that defines his own humanity increasingly indistinguishable from the artificial minds he destroys.
characters.synopsis: A blade runner hunts rogue replicants questioning what separates them from the human.

characters.name: Louise Banks
characters.note: Learning an alien language restructures her cognition until past, present, and future collapse into one simultaneous perception, turning grief into foreknowledge she chooses anyway.
characters.synopsis: A linguist deciphers an alien language that reshapes her sense of time.

characters.name: Theo Faron
characters.note: A burned-out bureaucrat is dragged from despair into custodianship of the last pregnancy on Earth, his cynicism dismantled by proximity to a miracle biotechnology cannot engineer.
characters.synopsis: In a world of global infertility, a man protects the first pregnant woman in decades.

characters.name: Zachry
characters.note: A tribal goatherd on a post-apocalyptic Earth is haunted by a devil-hallucination and by the sense that his soul is a recurrence of others across centuries, actions rippling through incarnations he'll never meet.
characters.synopsis: Six interlinked stories across centuries trace souls and consequences reincarnating through time.

characters.name: Dek
characters.note: A runt Predator discarded by his own clan bonds with a dismembered synthetic, redefining honor and kinship outside the biological hierarchy that declared him disposable.
characters.synopsis: A young Predator outcast partners with a synthetic on a hostile alien world.

characters.name: Ursa
characters.note: A Viking mother teaching her son survival through violence is forced to confront that the deadliest predator in the world renders her entire warrior code a rehearsal for something incomprehensibly larger.
characters.synopsis: Warriors across history face the ultimate hunter in interconnected vignettes.

characters.name: Freeman Lowell
characters.note: An ecologist isolated with Earth's last forests aboard a space freighter kills his crewmates and reprograms a service drone into a surrogate conscience, substituting machine companionship for a humanity he's abandoned.
characters.synopsis: An ecologist alone on a space station refuses orders to destroy Earth's last forests.

characters.name: Robert Thorn
characters.note: A police detective's investigation into an overpopulated future's food supply strips away his last illusion that the state feeding its citizens is separate from the corpses it processes.
characters.synopsis: A detective uncovers the horrifying source of a food substitute in an overpopulated future.

characters.name: Takeshi Kovacs
characters.note: A former Envoy soldier resleeved into an unfamiliar body after two and a half centuries in storage investigates a murder while his sense of self keeps dislocating from the flesh he currently wears.
characters.synopsis: In a future of transferable consciousness, a soldier investigates his host's murder.

characters.name: Myung-sook
characters.note: A factory girl hired as housemaid weaponizes seduction and a pregnancy to invert the household hierarchy, holding the composer and his wife hostage to her rage.
characters.synopsis: A new housemaid's affair with her employer destabilizes an entire household.

characters.name: Barbara Covett
characters.note: A veteran teacher converts a colleague's guilty secret into a private ledger of obligation, engineering isolation and dependence to secure companionship by blackmail.
characters.synopsis: A lonely teacher exploits a colleague's affair with a student to bind her closer.

characters.name: Reynolds Woodcock
characters.note: A couturier governs his house through ritualized routine and his dead mother's ghost, until his wife learns to seize control by poisoning him into helpless dependency.
characters.synopsis: A controlling dressmaker's relationship becomes a quiet battle for power.

characters.name: Queen Anne
characters.note: A gout-ridden, grief-hollowed monarch trades affection for governance, letting two women fight over her favor while she alone decides who gets to rule through her body.
characters.synopsis: Two women vie for the favor and power of an ailing, capricious queen.

characters.name: Mrs. Danvers
characters.note: Manderley's housekeeper preserves the dead first wife's room as a shrine and standard of comparison, using the estate's memory to psychologically dominate the living second wife.
characters.synopsis: A new bride is haunted by the memory of her husband's first wife.

characters.name: Ada McGrath
characters.note: A mute mail-order bride withholds speech and reclaims agency by trading piano keys for touch, converting her instrument into the one currency her husband cannot control.
characters.synopsis: A mute woman's piano becomes the site of a fraught colonial-era affair.

characters.name: Héloïse
characters.note: A daughter promised to a marriage she never chose asserts brief sovereignty over her own image by dictating the terms under which the painter is allowed to see her.
characters.filmTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
characters.synopsis: A painter and her reluctant subject fall in love before an arranged marriage.

characters.name: Carol Aird
characters.note: A wife facing a custody battle over a morality clause must perform respectability inside her own house while her husband weaponizes the home itself as evidence against her.
characters.synopsis: A young shopgirl and an older, unhappily married woman fall in love in 1950s New York.

characters.name: Elio Perlman
characters.note: A precocious son navigates his father's academic household where intellectual permissiveness doubles as surveillance, his desire shaped and ultimately blessed by paternal authority.
characters.synopsis: A summer romance between a teenager and an older graduate student reshapes his life.

characters.name: Laurence Alia
characters.note: A teacher's gender transition forces a renegotiation of domestic roles with her partner Fred, whose love curdles into possessive control as Laurence claims authorship over her own body.
characters.synopsis: A couple's love is tested when one partner transitions gender.

characters.name: Hubert Minel
characters.note: A teenager fabricates his mother's death to escape her surveillance, waging a war of humiliation and reconciliation in which the apartment itself becomes contested territory.
characters.synopsis: A teenager's fraught, loving relationship with his mother spirals into open warfare.

characters.name: Robert Ledgard
characters.note: A surgeon imprisons his daughter's attacker inside his own house, performing forced gender-reassignment surgery to remake the man's body into a substitute for his lost wife.
characters.synopsis: A surgeon's obsessive revenge against his daughter's attacker takes a monstrous form.

characters.name: Nina Sayers
characters.note: A ballerina kept childlike by a controlling mother in a pink shrine-bedroom fractures under a director's demand to surrender purity, splitting into a rival self to seize the role.
characters.synopsis: A ballerina's pursuit of perfection unravels her sanity and identity.

characters.name: Jack Torrance
characters.note: A caretaker-father is absorbed by the Overlook's inherited authority, the hotel's ghosts confirming and escalating his claim to rule his family through violence rather than provision.
characters.synopsis: A winter caretaker's isolation in a haunted hotel curdles into murderous madness.

characters.name: Beverly Mantle
characters.note: A gynecologist twin, the softer half of a shared identity, loses himself to drugs and a lover as the brothers' lifelong system of impersonation and mutual dependency collapses.
characters.synopsis: Identical twin gynecologists' shared life and lovers spirals into psychological collapse.

characters.name: Katherine Lester
characters.note: A young wife bought to breed an heir turns her husband's and father-in-law's rules against them, seizing the estate through murder and then sacrificing her servant Anna to keep it.
characters.synopsis: A trapped young wife's affair unleashes ruthless, murderous ambition.

characters.name: Nathan Algren
characters.note: A guilt-wrecked cavalry officer who massacred Native villages seeks penance by training the army meant to crush the samurai he ultimately joins.
characters.synopsis: A disillusioned American officer is captured by, and comes to admire, samurai resisters.

characters.name: Hal / King Henry V
characters.note: A tavern-dwelling prince who scorned kingship inherits a crown built on his father's usurpation and is dragged into the war he swore to avoid.
characters.synopsis: A reluctant young Prince Hal becomes king and must define his own rule.

characters.name: King George VI
characters.note: A stammering, unwilling monarch must master his own voice before he can be trusted to speak for a nation entering war.
characters.synopsis: A stammering king works with a speech therapist to lead Britain into war.

characters.name: Balian of Ibelin
characters.note: A grief-hollowed blacksmith rises to defend Jerusalem, then trades holy claim for human survival by surrendering the city he was sworn to hold.
characters.synopsis: A blacksmith turned knight defends Jerusalem amid the Crusades' religious politics.

characters.name: Edmond Dantès
characters.note: A wrongly imprisoned sailor reinvents himself as the Count of Monte Cristo, converting fourteen stolen years into a precisely engineered ruin of his betrayers.
characters.synopsis: A wrongly imprisoned man escapes to exact elaborate revenge on his betrayers.

characters.name: Scarlett O'Hara
characters.note: A willful plantation heiress converts the Civil War's destruction of her world into ruthless self-preservation, sacrificing love and honor to keep Tara.
characters.synopsis: A willful Southern belle survives the Civil War and its ruin of her world.

characters.name: Mark Zuckerberg
characters.note: A socially spurned Harvard sophomore builds an empire of connection while severing the one friendship that made it possible, verdict rendered only in depositions.
characters.synopsis: Facebook's founding is retold through the lawsuits and betrayals it left behind.

characters.name: Ray Kroc
characters.note: A failing milkshake-machine salesman seizes the McDonald brothers' invention and, through relentless legal and financial maneuvering, erases them from the empire it becomes.
characters.synopsis: A struggling salesman takes over and reshapes McDonald's, pushing out its founders.

characters.name: Wyatt
characters.note: A freedom-seeking biker's cross-country pilgrimage exposes his own countercultural ideal as fragile theater, ending in random, meaningless violence from the world he tried to escape.
characters.synopsis: Two bikers' cross-country journey collides with 1960s America's violent backlash.

characters.name: Benjamin Braddock
characters.note: A directionless graduate's rebellion against his parents' plastic future curdles into the same entitled drift he claims to reject, his rescue of Elaine reading as impulse rather than liberation.
characters.synopsis: An aimless graduate's affair with an older woman entangles him with her daughter.
